lxc_a7f6aacaf6311769.text: Today you visit Disneyland in California, from the front gate to lunch.

lxc_a13c0546e0e70fd7.text: You will learn how tickets, help from staff and food orders work, and then practise three real conversations.

lxc_5b0e09eda32c7b79.text: Disneyland in California is not just one park.

lxc_c0e2aff849ae7b9a.text: It is a big resort with many parts.

lxc_f407c80628e7ba11.text: It has two parks, Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure.

lxc_1dd37f59f8f46893.text: It also has Downtown Disney, a shopping and dining area.

lxc_7425d054463fa603.text: They are the Disneyland Hotel, Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa and Pixar Place Hotel.

lxc_0ec527d33f7503a3.text: Pixar Place Hotel got its new name in 2024.

lxc_7fda6ac3e8445ed1.text: Before your day, decide which park you want to visit.

lxc_4a45caa6e252a01e.text: Tickets work differently now than in the past.

lxc_9d947cad70452ae6.text: Before 1982, guests paid to go in.

lxc_8549b152918a0b8e.text: Then they paid again for each ride with special tickets.

lxc_d629d30990c9f79a.text: These ride tickets had letters, from A to C.

lxc_e9818d10075a691d.text: Since 1982, one admission price lets you use most attractions as often as you like.

lxc_52bc4fb9e7139fbc.text: You pay once and then you ride.

lxc_a7cbeeeebfa3ac4d.text: Where should you get your ticket?

lxc_ccebe591019f3810.text: You can get park tickets from the official Disneyland Resort website.

lxc_e83b9759a97f006c.text: This is a safe choice because it comes straight from Disney.

lxc_0244c1bdbe6f5008.text: The normal line is called the standby line.

lxc_9b149e8420c352c8.text: With these, you can skip the standby line at some rides, so you save time.

lxc_aac99ada5982abfd.text: Prices can change, so do not guess.

lxc_fcab0c190f8bd36a.text: Check the official website before you buy.

lxc_92bf38ea25bcd47d.text: Inside the park, the staff can help you with many things.

lxc_00d8f529a71fc908.text: A common question is about food.

lxc_ac0403ad53bdb144.text: This means you sit down, and a server brings your food.

lxc_bdc5ce84c2e55fc1.text: So how do you get a table?

lxc_c307a57f53fd27db.text: At some table-service restaurants, you can add your group to a walk-up list.

lxc_0939b1f9727a0e5b.text: You can do this only if the restaurant has space.

lxc_0d1e5332d3706916.text: You can check if there is space in two ways.

lxc_c511406837be7790.text: You can look in the app, or you can scan a QR code near the restaurant entrance.

lxc_833b6d70e46f9ede.text: You do not need to go to the host stand.

lxc_bf5fbb4876c1d137.text: The host stand is the desk at the front, where staff welcome guests.

lxc_c5f92df9e3bb4151.text: This is helpful for food needs too.

lxc_27973c620b2b9282.text: When you add your group to the list, you can confirm details in the app.

lxc_454b624cb0245d01.text: You can also tell the restaurant about special dietary needs.

lxc_62ea801ebea2413d.text: For example, maybe someone in your group cannot eat eggs.

lxc_a55879339694a2bb.text: You can write this in the app.

lxc_a6398971055d814c.text: You do not need to explain it out loud in a busy place.

lxc_c4f6059a04a6aa6a.text: What if the restaurant has no space?

lxc_16ebcd210d62cba6.text: Or what if you just want a quick meal?

lxc_a9237b0f6eb4c2c5.text: You can use the Disneyland app to order food and drinks ahead of time.

lxc_97fb555536ba8616.text: This works at some dining places in the park.

lxc_550e5da47331b157.text: Here is how it works, step by step.

lxc_8af3b964a543e9b5.text: Next, you pick an arrival time.

lxc_c7f74bf03d454b1e.text: This is the time you plan to come and get your food.

lxc_21697344d67b75df.text: That means you can change it.

lxc_d2e78e023f0b6b02.text: For example, you can take out something you do not want.

lxc_f3f28e0577849077.text: There are several ways to pay, including a Disney Gift Card and Apple Pay.

lxc_52a89fdd9d59a02b.text: The app can do more outside the parks too.

lxc_7afbe0affa7d23f8.text: If you stay at a Disneyland hotel, you can order meals and snacks in the app.

lxc_1ec4f14a7edbd6ab.text: Then you pick them up at some hotel locations.

lxc_5c253f1a5add8a82.text: You can also choose some Downtown Disney restaurants and see their food.

lxc_7a272bc39d67b66b.text: Some of them can deliver your order to a hotel lobby.

lxc_d994b3a5be4a35f7.text: It is early morning in California, and the sun is warm.

lxc_1dc87590daafc6ad.text: You are at the entrance of Disneyland Park, and your ticket is on your phone.

lxc_f23fee7e649135c0.text: A smiling staff member named Daniel is helping guests.

lxc_439ddc33e81ddcc3.text: Your goal is to make sure you are at the right entrance, show your ticket, and find out what Lightning Lane is and how to learn its price.

lxc_91d8548a358a67f4.text: It is late morning, and you are walking inside the park with your friend Emma.

lxc_3d3e3acd61188e38.text: You both want a sit-down lunch later, but the restaurants look busy.

lxc_0ecfd10acdc6b8c9.text: You see a staff member named Rosa near a map.

lxc_63e0721b117baa2d.text: Your goal is to find out how to get a table at a sit-down restaurant, and how to tell the restaurant that your friend cannot eat eggs.

lxc_31af88f08e473628.text: It is lunchtime, and you and Emma are sitting on a bench in the shade.

lxc_e161e3313bba551e.text: You checked the walk-up list, but there was no space.

lxc_c03cffceaaf4e79a.text: Emma is hungry, and you have the Disneyland app open on your phone.

lxc_646041407c475476.text: Your goal is to order lunch for both of you in the app, change Emma's food so it has no eggs, and pay.

lxc_f0a2c002a774612b.text: Plan a different day at the Disneyland Resort.

lxc_66074e651fbb0724.text: First, choose one park: Disneyland Park or Disney California Adventure.

lxc_158223cb9d0e5546.text: One person is the guest and one is park staff at the entrance.

lxc_73a52b88acd1dacc.text: The guest shows their ticket and asks about Lightning Lane.

lxc_49668a7468c7cac6.text: The staff explains it and says how to find the price.

lxc_e8b073b06af3c8cc.text: The guest asks staff for help getting a table.

lxc_12dad4a2a59b0ae8.text: The guest has a food need, for example no nuts or no meat.

lxc_cb10271ad24cd7b4.text: The staff explains the walk-up list and the QR code.

lxc_fde3566aaf57cb65.text: Two friends order lunch in the app.

lxc_a5d4521c83b74cc8.text: Go through every step: choose a restaurant, pick an arrival time, customize the food, and pay.

lxc_77812bea334c7150.text: Use at least five phrases from this lesson.

lxc_da9c062c429ef613.text: Then change roles and do it again.
